verdict.rationale: Omarchy exposes some CLI commands (e.g., omarchy-snapshot create, fip) and an official CLI manual page, suggesting some UI actions have command-line equivalents, but there is no evidence of a comprehensive API or CLI that mirrors the full Omarchy Menu (themes, installs, VM management, etc.), and llms.txt/OpenAPI probes both return 404s. missing for 10: a documented API or CLI covering the full range of UI actions (themes, environment setup, VM/Windows integration, snapshots) and any independent confirmation that non-UI users can perform every UI task programmatically.
